ارتديا (form VIII)
# اِرْتَدَيَا (irtadayā) /ir.ta.da.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِرْتَدَى (irtadā)
# اُرْتُدِيَا (urtudiyā) /ur.tu.di.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِرْتَدَى (irtadā)
# اِرْتَدِيَا (irtadiyā) /ir.ta.di.jaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِرْتَدَى (irtadā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
